scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Do you know what your child learned in today's Quran class?
Every class is live and one to one, for 30 minutes.
After every class, the teacher writes a short report.
It tells you where your child reached and what to practise next.
You can see every report on your family page.
See it for yourself: book a free trial class at nurulhudaacademy.org
